violated_contract: A synthetic or placeholder telemetry value (a device that does not expose a signal, e.g. a hardcoded battery level) must not drive system-level work as if it were a real reading. Each synthetic emission triggered a real side effect with OS cost: every 30s fake-battery tick reloaded the iOS widget timeline (2880 identical reloads/day) and refreshed UI state for a value that cannot change.
canonical_prevention: Emit synthetic values once per connection for initial state, and gate every side-effecting write (widget timeline reload, notification, persistence) on an actual value change or a real device signal. When a device lacks the signal, the emit-once path is the only path.
